This photo shows the leftovers after a meal: an almost empty plate with a few crumbs, a banana peel, an empty yogurt cup with a little residue, and two glasses with a small amount of liquid at the bottom.

Almost no food remains. I estimate the residue at about 5 g of crumbs, 3 g of yogurt, and a few grams of milk-like liquid, roughly 10–15 g in total. At about 1 kcal/g, that comes to around 12 kcal.
